## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Montpellier, France. It starts at Avenue du Palais de la Mer.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Getting to the bottom of the ocean can be a hassle. A much simpler way to see the ocean's incredible biodiversity up close is with a ticket to Seaquarium!
>
> This world-class aquarium is nestled on the southern tip of France in Grau-du-Roi, and is home to over 300 species of tropical fish, as well sharks, seals, sea lions, sea turtles, and other aquatic wildlife.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €20.10. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 155 ratings and 84 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
